    • updateEncryptionRecord

      protected Record[] updateEncryptionRecord(Record[] records, char[] password)
      Updates the encryption record for the given records using the supplied password. If password is null any existing encryption record is removed (decrypted output).
      Parameters:
      records - the current record array
      password - the output password, or null to remove encryption
      Returns:
      the updated record array
      Since:
      6.0.0

    • normalizeRecords

      protected static Record[] normalizeRecords(Record[] records)
      remove duplicated UserEditAtoms and merge PersistPtrHolder. Before this method is called, make sure that the offsets are correct, i.e. call HSLFSlideShowImpl.updateAndWriteDependantRecords(OutputStream, Map)
